name: Thanks for the Ride
source:
You took wrong turn, and ended up on a rural road in the middle of the night. A mysterious hitchhiker asks you for a ride home.

[From [url=https://lunar-hare-collective.itch.io/thanks-for-the-ride]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你拐错了弯，半夜走到了一条乡间小路上。一位神秘的搭便车者要你搭车回家。

[来自[url=https://lunar-hare-collective.itch.io/thanks-for-the-ride]itch.io[/url]]
